=={{header|Cxc}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="elixir">
def Pass:
    p: Int!
    d: Int!

def Door:
    is_open: Bool! = false
    -> idle
    idle <: toggle -> idle
        is_open => not self.is_open

def Hallway(doors: Int!):
    use console: Console
    cells: List of Door = []

    passes_done(c: Pass) :- c.p > self.doors
    row_done(c: Pass)    :- c.d > self.doors

    -> seeding
        self :> seed(1)

    seeding <: seed(n: Int):
        |:  n > self.doors -> running
            self :> step(Pass(1, 1))
        |?: -> seeding
            cells => self.cells.append(Door())
            self :> seed(n + 1)

    running <: step(c: Pass):
        |:  passes_done(c) -> printing
            self :> show(1)
        |:  row_done(c) -> running
            self :> step(Pass(c.p + 1, 1))
        |:  c.d % c.p == 0 -> running
            |> cells.at(c.d - 1).toggle()
            self :> step(Pass(c.p, c.d + 1))
        |?: -> running
            self :> step(Pass(c.p, c.d + 1))

    printing <: show(n: Int):
        |:  n > self.doors -> end
            :> done
        |:  self.cells.at(n - 1).is_open -> printing
            console.write("door " + n.to_string() + " open")
            self :> show(n + 1)
        |?: -> printing
            self :> show(n + 1)

def main:
    hall: Hallway = Hallway(100)
    -> running
    running <: hall.done -> end
</syntaxhighlight>
